sources.role: Finite sets equal iff every element has the same membership, independent of filter decision expression
sources.raw_excerpt:
@[ext, grind ext]
theorem ext {s₁ s₂ : Finset α} (h : ∀ a, a ∈ s₁ ↔ a ∈ s₂) : s₁ = s₂ :=
  SetLike.ext h

sources.role: Actual filter membership expands to original carrier membership and predicate
sources.raw_excerpt:
variable {p}

@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_filter {s : Finset α} {a : α} : a ∈ s.filter p ↔ a ∈ s ∧ p a :=
  Multiset.mem_filter

sources.role: Turn equality of the same membership propositions into iff
sources.raw_excerpt: theorem Iff.of_eq (h : a = b) : a ↔ b := h ▸ Iff.rfl

sources.role: Existing exact truncated-candidate source filter identity
sources.raw_excerpt:
theorem truncated_candidates_filter (e chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ)
    (N cap : ℕ) (hN : 1 < N) (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ (19 / 96 : ℝ) ≤ (cap : ℝ))
    (j : Label5 m) (a : ℝ) :
    (candidates e chi m omega N cap).filter
        (fun p => actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ logPrimeMeshCell 0 (19 / 96) m j ∧
          actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ logPrimeBox (fun _ => a) (fun _ => (19 / 96 : ℝ))) =
      (actualPrimeBoxTuples N (fun _ : Fin 5 => a) (fun _ => (19 / 96 : ℝ))).filter
        (fun p => actualPrimeTupleLog N p ∈ logPrimeMeshCell 0 (19 / 96) m j ∩
          jointRegion e chi m omega j) := by
  ext p
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, ht, hbox⟩
    have hg := (mem_candidates_iff_log_on_cell e chi m omega N cap hN hcap p j ht).mp hp
    exact ⟨(mem_actualPrimeBoxTuples_log_iff hN _ _ p).mpr
      ⟨fun i => ⟨(hg.1 i).1, (hg.1 i).2.1⟩, hbox⟩, ht, hg.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hp, ht, hg⟩
    have hpi := mem_actualPrimeBoxTuples_iff.mp hp
    have hbox := ((mem_actualPrimeBoxTuples_log_iff hN _ _ p).mp hp).2
    exact ⟨(mem_candidates_iff_log_on_cell e chi m omega N cap hN hcap p j ht).mpr
      ⟨fun i => ⟨(hpi i).1, (hpi i).2.1, Nat.cast_nonneg _, (hpi i).2.2.2⟩, hg⟩, ht, hbox⟩

sources.role: Original sourceRegion alias is mesh intersect same jointRegion
sources.raw_excerpt:
def sourceRegion (e : ℚ) (chi : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (omega : ℝ) (j : Label5 m) : Set (Fin 5 → ℝ) :=
  logPrimeMeshCell 0 (19 / 96) m j ∩ jointRegion (e : ℝ) chi m omega j
